captions: [{"start":0.03,"end":3.25,"text":"In June 2026, China did something small"},{"start":3.35,"end":5.4,"text":"that changed a very big market."},{"start":5.43,"end":7.39,"text":"It added two American companies to its"},{"start":7.4,"end":10.64,"text":"export control list, MP Materials and USA"},{"start":10.99,"end":12.04,"text":"Rare Earth."},{"start":12.07,"end":14.03,"text":"Those two names matter because they are"},{"start":14.03,"end":15.87,"text":"the center of America's plan to build a"},{"start":15.96,"end":18.85,"text":"Rare Earth supply chain outside China."},{"start":18.89,"end":21.3,"text":"By naming them, Beijing was not banning"},{"start":21.39,"end":22.72,"text":"anything outright."},{"start":22.75,"end":24.36,"text":"It was showing exactly where the leverage"},{"start":24.71,"end":25.02,"text":"sits."},{"start":25.05,"end":26.92,"text":"This is the question we are going to"},{"start":26.92,"end":27.4,"text":"unpack."},{"start":27.43,"end":29.05,"text":"Why can a small set of choke points affect"},{"start":29.4,"end":31.61,"text":"cars, chips, and even defense?"},{"start":31.89,"end":33.51,"text":"The short answer is that the world's Rare"},{"start":33.85,"end":36.28,"text":"Earth supply runs through a gate, and one"},{"start":36.28,"end":37.64,"text":"country holds the keys."},{"start":37.67,"end":39.9,"text":"Start with the materials themselves."},{"start":39.93,"end":42.44,"text":"Rare Earths are a family of 17 elements"},{"start":42.47,"end":44.69,"text":"you have probably never heard of, but they"},{"start":44.71,"end":47.15,"text":"are inside almost everything electric."},{"start":47.21,"end":49.44,"text":"The magnets in electric vehicle motors,"},{"start":49.47,"end":51.84,"text":"the turbines in wind farms, the guidance"},{"start":51.84,"end":54.24,"text":"systems in defense hardware, the vibration"},{"start":54.24,"end":56.6,"text":"motor in your phone, they are called rare,"},{"start":56.63,"end":58.74,"text":"but they are not actually scarce in the"},{"start":58.74,"end":59.38,"text":"ground."},{"start":59.41,"end":61.4,"text":"The leverage is not in the mining."},{"start":61.43,"end":62.83,"text":"It is in the processing."},{"start":62.87,"end":64.96,"text":"Here is the number that matters."},{"start":64.99,"end":67.16,"text":"China mines a large share of the world's"},{"start":67.16,"end":70.48,"text":"Rare Earths around 70%, but it processes"},{"start":70.57,"end":73.23,"text":"an even bigger share, roughly 90% of"},{"start":73.23,"end":75.71,"text":"global separation capacity, and close to"},{"start":75.71,"end":78.1,"text":"99% of the heavy Rare Earths used in the"},{"start":78.17,"end":79.76,"text":"most demanding magnets."},{"start":79.79,"end":81.76,"text":"So when a country exports raw ore and"},{"start":81.76,"end":83.89,"text":"imports refined magnets, it has already"},{"start":83.89,"end":85.36,"text":"passed through one gate."},{"start":85.39,"end":88.16,"text":"That gate is Chinese separation capacity."},{"start":88.19,"end":89.81,"text":"This is the definition we need."},{"start":89.95,"end":91.57,"text":"A choke point is not the mine."},{"start":91.83,"end":93.56,"text":"It is the gate after the mine, the"},{"start":93.56,"end":96.1,"text":"refinery, the separator, the magnet maker,"},{"start":96.13,"end":98.27,"text":"where a handful of facilities concentrate"},{"start":98.27,"end":99.32,"text":"world supply."},{"start":99.35,"end":101.48,"text":"Think of the chain as four steps."},{"start":101.51,"end":103.57,"text":"First, the mine, ore comes out of the"},{"start":103.57,"end":106.1,"text":"ground in California, Australia, Myanmar,"},{"start":106.1,"end":107.09,"text":"and elsewhere."},{"start":107.17,"end":109.56,"text":"Second, the refinery, that ore is crushed,"},{"start":109.62,"end":111.72,"text":"separated, and turned into individual"},{"start":111.72,"end":112.36,"text":"oxides."},{"start":112.39,"end":114.8,"text":"This is the hard, dirty, capital-intensive"},{"start":114.8,"end":116.76,"text":"step, and it is where China holds its"},{"start":117.11,"end":117.55,"text":"position."},{"start":117.59,"end":119.95,"text":"Third, the magnet, the oxides become the"},{"start":119.95,"end":121.96,"text":"permanent magnets inside motors and"},{"start":121.96,"end":123,"text":"generators."},{"start":123.03,"end":125.62,"text":"Fourth, the factory, those magnets go into"},{"start":125.68,"end":128.56,"text":"cars, wind turbines, robots, and weapons."},{"start":128.59,"end":131.17,"text":"Each step passes value to the next, and at"},{"start":131.17,"end":133.17,"text":"step two, most of the world's ore stops"},{"start":133.23,"end":134.4,"text":"for processing."},{"start":134.43,"end":136.65,"text":"Here is what that concentration looks like"},{"start":136.65,"end":137.4,"text":"in prices."},{"start":137.43,"end":139.92,"text":"Neodymium praseodymium oxide, the key"},{"start":139.92,"end":142.44,"text":"feedstock for permanent magnets, opened"},{"start":142.51,"end":145.88,"text":"2026 near $53 a kilogram."},{"start":145.91,"end":149.9,"text":"By July, spot quotes were above $110."},{"start":149.93,"end":152.32,"text":"China's Rare Earth price index reached"},{"start":152.32,"end":153.24,"text":"270."},{"start":153.27,"end":158.05,"text":"Five on 24 July, 2026, about 170% above"},{"start":158.39,"end":160.62,"text":"its 2010 baseline."},{"start":160.71,"end":162.89,"text":"Prices stopped being a market story and"},{"start":162.89,"end":164.64,"text":"became a policy story."},{"start":164.67,"end":166.29,"text":"That is why markets care."},{"start":166.59,"end":168.78,"text":"The sectors that depend on these magnets"},{"start":168.78,"end":169.74,"text":"are enormous."},{"start":169.77,"end":171.8,"text":"The International Energy Agency has"},{"start":171.8,"end":174.41,"text":"pointed to the huge value of output that"},{"start":174.41,"end":177.11,"text":"is directly exposed to magnet supply on"},{"start":177.12,"end":179.31,"text":"the order of $6.5 trillion."},{"start":179.35,"end":181.25,"text":"A shock at the choke point does not stay"},{"start":181.25,"end":182.72,"text":"in the mining sector."},{"start":182.75,"end":185.05,"text":"It ripples into electric vehicles, into"},{"start":185.08,"end":187.32,"text":"wind energy, into the cost of the energy"},{"start":187.32,"end":189.65,"text":"transition, and into defense procurement."},{"start":189.87,"end":191.86,"text":"So what is the West doing about it?"},{"start":191.89,"end":195.06,"text":"In February, 2026, the United States"},{"start":195.06,"end":197.76,"text":"launched FORGE, a 54-nation alliance"},{"start":197.76,"end":201.03,"text":"backed by Project Vault, a $12 billion"},{"start":201.12,"end":203.13,"text":"fund, to rebuild critical minerals supply"},{"start":203.48,"end":204.71,"text":"chains outside China."},{"start":204.75,"end":206.81,"text":"MP Materials has a partnership with the"},{"start":206.81,"end":208.78,"text":"Department of Defense to build domestic"},{"start":208.86,"end":210.2,"text":"magnet production."},{"start":210.23,"end":211.45,"text":"That is the plan."},{"start":211.51,"end":213.52,"text":"Here is the honest uncertainty."},{"start":213.55,"end":215.84,"text":"Rebuilding separation capacity is not like"},{"start":215.84,"end":217.28,"text":"reopening a mine."},{"start":217.31,"end":218.48,"text":"It takes years."},{"start":218.51,"end":220.61,"text":"Analysts say a realistic timeline for"},{"start":220.61,"end":222.88,"text":"meaningful Western separation runs to the"},{"start":222.95,"end":225.12,"text":"end of the decade, and full independence"},{"start":225.17,"end":227.25,"text":"could take 20 to 30 years."},{"start":227.29,"end":229.68,"text":"The infrastructure, the chemistry, and the"},{"start":229.68,"end":231.67,"text":"skilled labor all have to be built from a"},{"start":231.67,"end":232.35,"text":"small base."},{"start":232.39,"end":234.6,"text":"So the race is not against a deadline."},{"start":234.63,"end":237.22,"text":"It is against a gate that already exists."},{"start":237.27,"end":239.51,"text":"The signal to watch is not the headline"},{"start":239.51,"end":240.14,"text":"price."},{"start":240.17,"end":242.24,"text":"It is the behavior underneath it."},{"start":242.27,"end":243.88,"text":"Watch whether new separation plants"},{"start":244.07,"end":246.87,"text":"outside China actually come online."},{"start":246.95,"end":248.95,"text":"Watch whether Western automakers and"},{"start":248.95,"end":251.26,"text":"defense buyers sign long-term magnet"},{"start":251.26,"end":254,"text":"contracts at higher prices or keep buying"},{"start":254,"end":254.52,"text":"spot."},{"start":254.55,"end":256.41,"text":"Watch whether the entity list grows from"},{"start":256.41,"end":259.49,"text":"10 American firms in June to 14 European"},{"start":259.49,"end":261.46,"text":"firms in July, because that tells you the"},{"start":261.54,"end":263.98,"text":"choke point is being used deliberately."},{"start":264.01,"end":266.1,"text":"The mine was never the story."},{"start":266.13,"end":268.16,"text":"The gate was always the story."},{"start":268.19,"end":270.6,"text":"One country, a small set of facilities,"},{"start":270.63,"end":273.25,"text":"and a 17-element family of metals that the"},{"start":273.26,"end":275.63,"text":"modern economy cannot build without."},{"start":275.69,"end":277.24,"text":"That is the leverage."},{"start":277.27,"end":280.2,"text":"And in 2026, it has a price tag."},{"start":280.23,"end":281.85,"text":"The question for the next phase of the"},{"start":282.2,"end":284.92,"text":"global economy is not whether rare
